encryption_details.algorithm: Layered repeating-key XOR and standard RC4 (KSA/PRGA), applied in place to a 64-byte payload. Runtime decryption first XORs the blob with the 10-byte repeating key and then applies RC4; because both layers are XOR streams, this reverses the build-time layering.
encryption_details.key: XOR key (hex): DE AD BE EF 13 37 CA FE BA BE; RC4 key (ASCII): Hollowing_PE!!!!
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys are stored in cleartext in .rdata: the 10-byte binary XOR key at VA 0x140005000 and the 16-byte RC4 key at VA 0x140005010. The 64-byte ciphertext is stored at VA 0x140004000 in .data, copied to the stack, and decrypted in place before injection. No IV is used.

decoded_strings.note: The encrypted 64-byte object is consumed as raw executable payload rather than as a verified printable string. Native API names ntdll.dll, NtQueryInformationProcess, NtUnmapViewOfSection, and NtReadVirtualMemory are already plaintext in .rdata.

anti_analysis: NtQueryInformationProcess with ProcessDebugPort (information class 7); treats a returned debug port of -1 as debugger detection
NtQueryInformationProcess with ProcessDebugFlags (information class 0x1F); treats a returned value of 0 as debugger detection
Early return before payload decryption and injection when either native anti-debug check triggers
Dynamic resolution of ntdll native APIs through GetModuleHandleA and GetProcAddress, keeping them out of the static import table
Target path is assembled from immediate chunks on the stack rather than stored as one ordinary string
Sleep(2000) delay after the hollowing attempt

injection_details.method: Process hollowing / suspended-process image replacement using CreateProcessA(CREATE_SUSPENDED) + NtUnmapViewOfSection + VirtualAllocEx + WriteProcessMemory + GetThreadContext/SetThreadContext + ResumeThread
injection_details.target_discovery: No process enumeration. A hard-coded absolute path is assembled on the stack and passed as the CreateProcessA command line with creation flag 0x4 (CREATE_SUSPENDED).
injection_details.remote_image_base_discovery: Calls dynamically resolved NtQueryInformationProcess with ProcessBasicInformation (class 0), obtains the remote PEB, then uses dynamically resolved NtReadVirtualMemory to read the original ImageBaseAddress from PEB+0x10.
injection_details.image_replacement: Calls dynamically resolved NtUnmapViewOfSection on the original image base. It first requests MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE memory at that same base with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE; if that fails it retries at an arbitrary address.
injection_details.payload_write: Copies the 64-byte ciphertext from .data, decrypts it in memory with the repeating XOR and RC4 layers, and writes the resulting raw 64-byte buffer in one WriteProcessMemory call. It does not manually map PE sections.
injection_details.thread_redirection: Requests x64 CONTEXT flags 0x10000B, sets CONTEXT.Rcx to the remote allocation (the payload start), applies SetThreadContext, and resumes the primary thread with ResumeThread.
